It was accepted that a s135(2) warrant should have been applied for on 4 October 2022. The process for obtaining a warrant is that an application has to be made for a video hearing at either Uxbridge or Westminster Magistrates' Courts. Once the Magistrates issued a warrant, an appointment would then be arranged for the police to execute the warrant.
